name: Bakersfield Recovery Services
excerpt: Residential and intensive outpatient substance use treatment focused on personal growth, accountability, and long-term recovery.
paragraph: Bakersfield Recovery Services guides individuals toward a drug-free, empowered life through men’s, women’s, and perinatal residential treatment, along with intensive outpatient care. Its evidence-based programs emphasize personal growth, individual responsibility, and the coping skills that support long-term recovery. Guided by empathy, integrity, empowerment, and family and community involvement, BRS prioritizes the well-being of individuals, their families, and the community throughout the recovery journey.
